text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After talking it over with Sakura Laurel, 
we decided to save her direct showdown 
with Narita Brian for the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on this day—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the Hanshin Daishoten! This will be 
Narita Brian's first race of the year!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooo~~~, Briaaan!! Show us your 
strength--!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Brian-chan's popularity is truly 
incredible...!
choice_data_list:
Maybe she was the "long-awaited hero" 
after all, huh

Maybe she was the "long-awaited hero" 
after all

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the world of racing, "heroes" emerge 
time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Strength, star power, and a passion that 
makes people want to cheer. Among all the 
different ideals of a hero, what Narita 
Brian showed us was—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —An unwavering strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how many Umamusume throughout history 
have truly been worthy of being engraved 
as 'the strongest'?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Legends are born only in fleeting moments. 
Therefore, the witnesses who see them are 
few.
choice_data_list:
(That's why everyone wants to be a 
witness.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Rather than learning about her 'after the 
fact' as a figure of the past, I want to 
witness the 'present' in which she lives."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Not merely a figure talked about in 
history, but that very Umamusume I know—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —That she is the one and only "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Brian-chan was the perfect fit for the 
title of "Strongest Umamusume" that 
everyone had been waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "...―― A true hero, indeed."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And now, that very Umamusume, Narita 
Brian, enters the track as well!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Phew... *huff*, *puff*...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't Brian's intensity insane today...? 
It's like steam's practically rising off 
her before she even runs...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what incredible presence!! She's 
definitely going to make history today...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Brian leads! Brian is in the lead!! 
Entering the home straight, her lead is 
only widening!

text_block_list.name: Man with Undercut
text_block_list.text:
Wha, what speed! Haha... wow, she's 
insane...!

text_block_list.name: Pierced Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously, even though it's a 3000m race, 
—I've never seen a finishing burst like 
that...!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Not a shadow of doubt for Brian! Not a 
single shadow of doubt! A majestic 
first-place finish, and she crosseees the 
finish liiine!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A dominant win for Narita Brian! This year 
is hers once again! She's now one step 
away from the Spring Shield!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Youth Wearing a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Dude, for real... If it's him, he's gonna 
make our dreams come true...

text_block_list.name: Youth Wearing a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Take first place in every single GI race! 
And blow past Rudolf's GI record too!

text_block_list.name: Youth Wearing a Hat
text_block_list.text:
She could even win the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, for sure! The first glory in 
Tracen Academy's history... she can do it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...It really feels like she's leaving me 
behind. The one I've always admired so 
much."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
But you could also say that makes it all 
the more rewarding to pass them!
choice_data_list:
The decisive battle is the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

Our big showdown is the Tenno Sho 
(Spring), right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'll overtake that run of hers, just 
watch me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "monster" Narita Brian, who continued 
to evolve— her brilliance remained, as 
always, the goal.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —...Whoa. It's so sparkly...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, amazing—she's so fast! So this 
is Narita Brian-san's running!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa☆ My heart won't stop pounding. It's 
racing so fast, it's so thrilling...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Maya too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"If I run with Brian-san, do you think I 
can become sparkly too?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eheh—♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days had passed since Narita Brian's 
shocking performance in the Hanshin 
Daishoten stunned the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A piece of breaking news took the world by 
storm.

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news. Narita Brian has announced 
that she will withdraw from the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) due to an injury.

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
"After the Hanshin Daishoten, she felt 
discomfort in her lower back, and detailed 
examinations revealed an abnormality in 
her hip joint."

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
She announced that she will prioritize 
recovering from her injury for the time 
being and refrain from entering races.

text_block_list.name: Customer outside Convenience Store A
text_block_list.text: No way, Brian got injured...

text_block_list.name: Customer outside Convenience Store B
text_block_list.text:
...I heard she's going in and out of the 
hospital for a while, so she won't be 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, so that means we won't get to see 
Lady Brian run anymore~?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text:
And taking such a long break must mean 
it's a really severe injury...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Still, Brian will make a comeback! Without 
a doubt! Definitely!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Right! Her mental game is total monster 
tier too! Even at the Kikuka Sho, she was 
so strong that none of the anxiety or 
tension around her mattered at all!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
I'll finish my rehab and be right back! 
Because—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: —Because they're our "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's been announced that Brian-chan will 
be bypassing the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...It is a bit regrettable. The day when 
we could compete for the pinnacle with all 
our might has been pushed further away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Still, what we need to do remains the 
same!
choice_data_list:
This is our chance to close the gap they 
put on display!

This is our chance to close the gap they 
showed us!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"That's right♪ We need to make up for the 
ground Brian-chan gained on us in the 
Hanshin Daishoten!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: We're not the ones who wait, after all.
